board: Keyes / Joy-IT KY-017 tilt switch module (black 3-pin sensor-kit board with tilt-switch capsule, 680 Ohm resistor and indicator LED; header S, + (middle), -)
reason: Modelled as an active-low digital sensor (tilt switch from S to GND, LED + 680 Ohm from + to S as a weak pull-up, so the driver enables the internal pull-up; S LOW and LED on when closed); check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run. Polarity rests on the Joy-IT manual (no external pull-up, falling edge = detection) and vendor notes that the LED is on while the output is low; no published schematic was found.
breakoutPinoutSource: Joy-IT SensorKit X40 manual p.77 (Signal, +V, GND) https://cdn-reichelt.de/documents/datenblatt/A300/SEN-KIT02_ANL.pdf, board photo https://sensorkit.joy-it.net/files/files/sensors/KY-017/KY-017.png, arduinomodules.info (S, middle +, -)
